subject: Rename files redisassert to serverassert (#138)
reason: The change only renames src/redisassert.c/.h to src/serverassert.c/.h (100% similarity renames), updates the matching #include lines in ae.c, dict.c, intset.c, kvstore.c, listpack.c, memtest.c, monotonic.c, quicklist.c, rax.c, sds.c, ziplist.c, zmalloc.c, and swaps redisassert.o for serverassert.o in the Makefile object lists. It is a pure build/refactor change with no behaviour change: no command, reply, replication, persistence or cluster path is altered, and any mistake would surface as a compile/link failure, not a runtime bug. No scenario is needed.
